INSERT INTO tag_categories (user_id, name, color, position)
                VALUES (
                    $1,
                    $2,
                    $3,
                    COALESCE(
                        (SELECT MAX(position) + 1 FROM tag_categories WHERE user_id = $1),
                        0
                    )
                )
            RETURNING
                id,
                user_id,
                name,
                color,
                position,
                created_at,
                updated_at
